ideas.title: Add a guided first-time user experience
ideas.problem: New users may not immediately understand where to start or what actions are available when they first open the application. This can make the initial experience confusing and increase the learning curve.
ideas.solution: Introduce a short interactive walkthrough when a user accesses the application for the first time. The walkthrough would highlight the main features, explain important buttons and navigation options, and provide a quick introduction should be able to understand the application more quickly, navigate confidently to the application's core functionality.
ideas.benefit: Users should be able to understand the application more quickly, navigate confidently, and start using its main features without needing external instructions.

ideas.title: Add Suspicious Login Detection
ideas.problem: Unauthorized users may attempt to access accounts using unusual login locations, repeated failed attempts, or unfamiliar devices.
ideas.solution: Detect suspicious login patterns and flag authentication attempts that exceed configurable security rules.
ideas.benefit: Improve account security and help administrators identify potentially unauthorized access.

ideas.title: Automate Regression Tests for Critical Features
ideas.problem: Changes to existing functionality can introduce bugs because critical workflows are not consistently tested before releases.
ideas.solution: Create an automated regression test suite for critical application workflows and run it whenever code changes are submitted.
ideas.benefit: Catch regressions earlier, reduce manual testing effort, and improve release reliability.
